product_specification.provider: WorldPop Research Group, University of Southampton
product_specification.units: Estimated number of persons (people per pixel / count)
product_specification.methodology: Random Forest dasymetric spatial disaggregation calibrated to UN WPP national totals

exposure_semantics.population_count_definition: Total estimated resident persons within the H3 Resolution 9 hexagonal cell (~9.86 ha), computed via area-weighted dasymetric sum conservation.
exposure_semantics.population_density_definition: Estimated persons per square kilometer: population_count / 0.098623 km².
exposure_semantics.conservation_guarantee: Demographic mass conserved within <= 0.05% against exact polygon intersection
exposure_semantics.nodata_policy: Zero or negative pixels treated as 0.0 population (unpopulated/water/void)

quality_and_uncertainty.demographic_uncertainty_classification: CLIMORA_ASSUMPTION (Methodological sensitivity parameter; empirical urban parcel downscaling uncertainty is unquantified at hexagon scale in India)
quality_and_uncertainty.census_base_year: Census of India 2011 projected to 2020 via UN Population Division growth rates
quality_and_uncertainty.suitability: Optimal for relative intra-urban heat exposure prioritization; not statutory census enumeration
quality_and_uncertainty.floating_population_limitation: Represents ambient residential nighttime population; does not capture diurnal peak commuter influx in commercial central business districts (CBDs).
